title: THE LONG WAY BACK · X · The hole in the road
venue: the sabbatical · never posted · found in Box 9
logline: Stop ten: 101 closed, a hole in the road the width of both lanes and no bottom the flashlight finds, a flagger with a sign, the detour up a logging road. The card in the drawer that night is a wheel. The traveler draws the hole from the edge and doesn't draw the bottom.

panels.composition: Tier 1: 101 closed: a ragged hole across both lanes, a flagger with a STOP sign, the Datsun stopped, the dog's head out the window.
